facts.fact: INTIC states that its 16 November 2023 interoperability meeting results from applying the Electronic Transactions Law, Lei 3/2017 of 9 January.

MOZ.note: Decreto 67/2017 is named but its subject and link to the law are not stated, so no rules made under it are recorded.
A stakeholder meeting on interoperability states no online service.

facts.fact: INTIC states that the e-government interoperability work applies the Regulamento do Quadro de Interoperabilidade dos Sistemas do Governo Electronico, Decreto 90/2020 of 9 October.
facts.system: Quadro de Interoperabilidade dos Sistemas do Governo Electronico

MOZ.note: No requirement on public bodies or enforcing body is stated, and the meeting on 16 November 2023 was to discuss technical specifications, not to show bodies following the framework.

facts.fact: INTIC states that it is implementing the Regulamento do Quadro de Interoperabilidade dos Sistemas do Governo Electronico, issued as Decreto 90/2020 of 9 October.

MOZ.note: The document does not say the decree obliges public bodies to share data.
